replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
OK I downloaded the map, I like the size of the mini-map, I like the mine, and the theme, but the top could use more land. The yml is broken and the map was built in creative ( not really a problem, but when building on creative try and make sure the only blocks generated are air in the presets )

So to reiterate:

-The main walls structures will need to be moved to a void world, and the yml will need to be rebuilt. The item mix is  good, from what i could see, the mines are great for the mini-map. I would suggest to add more land and a few more details to the over world and let me know when it is updated. If you need help moving the world or rebuilding the yml I will help, but I leave it up to you to add the needed land and details to the surface.
